# Agentcy

> Agentcy — AI Engineers on Site | Ballito & Knysna | South Africa

Agentcy sends AI engineers into South African businesses to eliminate operational drag. We audit, architect, and automate workflows, AI integrations, and custom tools. Founded 2023, working nationally across South Africa.

## Services
- AI Integration: embed AI into your existing tools as a working layer
- Workflow Automation: map end-to-end processes, eliminate manual handoffs
- Custom Tools: internal dashboards, calculators, trackers built to fit
- Agentic Solutions: autonomous agents that monitor, act, escalate
- WhatsApp CRM Setup: automated replies, lead capture, follow-up, CRM sync
- Knowledge Base & SOP Documentation

## Process
01 Discovery & Audit → 02 Automation Blueprint → 03 Build & Integration → 04 Deployment & Scaling

## Pricing
- Starter Audit: R8,000 once-off
- Growth: R18,999/month (R17,099/month annual)
